company.shortDescription: Stitch develops payment infrastructure and financial technology tools that support online and in-person transactions for businesses.
company.description: Stitch develops payment infrastructure and financial technology tools that support online and in-person transactions for businesses. The company provides APIs and payment solutions for bank transfers, card payments, recurring billing, payouts, and financial data connectivity. Its platform enables businesses to manage payment processing, customer authentication, reconciliation, and transaction reporting through integrated systems and developer tools. Stitch also supports checkout customization, fraud monitoring, and payment orchestration across multiple financial service providers. The company works with enterprises and digital platforms across sectors such as retail, financial services, and commerce to support payment operations and money movement processes.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $25,000,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $57,307,690 to $147,844,766, a 2.58x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 91 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-27).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
